dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Hmm... So many businesses, so much potential. All they lack is a guide to help build up their brand image.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are?

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Hello there, my friendly and passionate friend. I'm Vert Jr., and I hail from Quartier Lyonnais in the Court of Fontaine, where I'm really known as Petit Vert.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: After arriving in Yilong Wharf, my friends in Liyue nicknamed me Vert Jr. based on my name's meaning.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Vert, or green, is the color of tea leaves. So far, it's made the locals more affable toward me and helped build my personal brand...

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: And in the long term, I'll be having an extended stay in Yilong Wharf to carefully study and promote the local cuisine.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Hmm... Why don't I call my first travel guide "Vert's Vouchsafes"!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Brand image?

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: What do you think? It's your first time hearing this term, I'll bet!

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: My elder sister Rouge and I are both representatives of this profession!

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: We still haven't made a name for ourselves in the Court of Fontaine, sure, but many stores have sought out our help!

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: We offer comprehensive assistance to stores to improve their public brand, including but not limited to advertisements, news columns, short videos, large-scale events, etc.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: For many stores, their excellent service is not reflected in their reputation. However, through the publicity we offer, we will bring their repute up to par with their ability.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: According to the information we've collected, some restaurants in Liyue are suffering from this issue...

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Most restaurants here offer delicious cuisine at reasonable prices, so they rarely have any competitors in the same price range. Residents only need to spend a small amount of Mora to enjoy a sumptuous feast.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: However, more high-end food and beverage brands are needed... After all, even chefs require the support of a brand image.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: If all restaurants operated on a small scale, the culinary profession would be seen as tons of work for little money. Few would be willing to take up the culinary arts.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: If this profession is to have a future, we'll also need outfits that target the wealthy, earn big, and pay chefs handsomely...

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: This high-low combination will allow the general public to enjoy delicious food without worry. It would also be respectable to be a chef, and you'd be paid proportionately to your skill.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Maybe I can help improve this situation... I'll need to get a better understanding of Liyue's food industry first, though.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Best to start our research from Yilong Wharf before gradually expanding outward...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry to bother you.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Oh my, how polite of you... Feel free to come chat with me anytime!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A tourism guidebook?

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Heh! My sister Rouge and I have dedicated ourselves to the discovery of sights worth visiting and cuisine worth tasting.

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Gorgeous views and delicious food are treasures that belong to everyone in Teyvat. Every tourist should seize the opportunity to enjoy them!

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: But non-frequent visitors must inquire about the scenic spots and cuisine from scratch...

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: What a bother! It would probably take them years, just like it's taking me!

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Just think! How convenient would things be if we had one... Or even several detailed, comprehensive guides to refer to?

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: That's exactly why my sister and I have decided to explore every settlement in Teyvat. We'll create that very series of travel guides for the sake of all tourists!

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Things have been going very smoothly, and we only encountered a small hiccup along the way...

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Problem being that my sister found herself unused to the food outside of Fontaine, so we had to switch jobs...

dialogues.speaker: Vert Jr.
dialogues.text: Now, her Rouge's Registry will be a record of scenic attractions, while my Vert's Vouchsafes will be about cuisine!
